name: Calling
source:
Girl is interested in self-exposure. She sees a kindred soul in main character and confesses to him about her habits, but she is mistaken and gets into sexual slavery instead. With her help, her sister becomes a sex slave as well. Main character is to train two girls in exposure and various techniques.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名少女对自我暴露感兴趣。她从主人公身上看见同类，便向他坦白自己的习惯；但她判断错了，最终反而沦为性奴。在她的帮助下，妹妹也成了性奴。主人公将训练两名少女进行暴露与各种技巧。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
